en.headline: Water supply resumes in Shau Kei Wan after main repair
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department said service began returning from 9.30pm on Tuesday following emergency repairs to a pipe damaged during roadworks, which had affected about 10,000 premises.
body: Fresh water supply to users in Shau Kei Wan and parts of Sai Wan Ho began to resume progressively from 9.30pm on Tuesday after emergency repairs to a damaged underground main were completed, the Water Supplies Department said.

The department stated that the pipe on Shau Kei Wan Road had been damaged during separate road maintenance works by another contractor, disrupting supply to about 10,000 households and businesses. Because the affected network is extensive, restoration times varied by location, elevation and floor level, with users at the ends of the network or on higher ground potentially waiting an additional three to four hours.

Temporary water supply points, supported by water trucks and tanks, remained in place until normal service returned. The department advised that tap water might initially appear milky or cloudy due to air bubbles and recommended running the water for a few minutes after removing the strainer until it cleared.
This was the second major disruption in the area since July. The Highways Department has been linked to the roadworks that damaged the main.

zh.headline: 笹箕灣水管維修完成 供水周二晚上九時半起逐步恢復
zh.dek: 水務署表示，緊急維修完成後，笹箕灣及部分西灣河用戶的食水供應由周二晚上九時半起陸續恢復，早前事故影響約一萬戶。
body: 水務署表示，笹箕灣道一條地下食水總管在路面維修工程中受損，經緊急搶修後，供應已於周二晚上九時半起逐步恢復。
署方指，事故影響笹箕灣及部分西灣河約一萬個用戶。由於管網範圍廣闊及複雜，個別用戶恢復供水的時間因地形、距離、管道狀況及樓層而有所不同。位於管網末端或較高位置的用戶，可能需額外三至四小時才有水到戶。
臨時供水點、水車及水箱會繼續運作，直至所有用戶恢復正常。署方提醒，恢復供水初期水中可能含有氣泡，呈現乳白色或微濁，屬正常現象，建議先拆除水龍頭隔濾器，放水數分鐘至清澈後再裝回。
這是該區自七月以來第二次大型停水事故。有關路面工程據報涉及路政署相關工程。
